notes.subject: graun bilong ol man insait
notes.rationale: תבל i graun we ol man i stap long en (olsem wanpela wörld), narapela tok long ארץ

notes.subject: ותחולל
notes.rationale: summa i tok 'yu foemim' — tasol wanem i mekim dispela wok? Em i 'twistim olgeta samting i kamapdaun' — hia mi ritim olsem God i no bin kirapim yet (i go wantaim בטרם), narapela ritim i 'wantaim yu kirapim'

notes.subject: oltaim i go inap long oltaim
notes.rationale: םעולם עד עולם i makim taim — long past tru i go long Future tru

translation: Bihain yet ol maunten i no kamap, na yu no bin kirapim ⟨את⟩ graun na ⟨את⟩ graun bilong ol man insait yet, olsem na ating oltaim, i go inap long oltaim, yu El.
